interpretation: Fully first-contact (NO banked solve): explore -> stumble a win -> induce the agent (general method) -> induce the GOAL OBJECT colour (what the agent reached) -> solve via best_first_search guided by agent-to-goal-colour distance. A first-contact solve = the unseen-game pipeline works end to end on that game. Honest limit: only games whose win is STUMBLE-ABLE within the explore budget can have a goal induced this way; deep-solve games need curious/directed exploration or goal PERCEPTION (the remaining frontier).
